{{Top|leg}}
'''Charged-particle vibrating waves''' were used in the construction of [[molecularly bonded armor]]. The waves bombarded [[Metal/Legends|metal]] that had been liquified by [[ion fuser]]s and held in place by [[texture-molding tractor field]]s. This process increased the strength of each molecule's subatomic bonding strength, which in turn gave the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] increased resilience.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
